scope: Observed PC baseline, not a causal cold/warm comparison or physical-phone benchmark
sourceReadback: The unchanged baseline server controller matches that Git blob; global site chrome was the earlier PC checkpoint.
limitations: Original arrival avatars differ between visits and are retained in each model timing; no speedup is inferred from cold vs warm.
WebKit Windows phone profile reports Apple GPU as a privacy label, not actual Apple hardware.
WebKit has no Long Tasks API; reported zero entries mean unsupported, not no long tasks.
Flicker captures read back and downsample actual frames; their intervals are not clean FPS measurements.
Physical iPhone numbers remain pending from Sirui.
